The 7-day figures ($90 / $150) are identical on both pages, so the tie-break is the week-to-month ratio: Go 55/220 = 25.0%, Plus 74/290 = 25.5%, and 90/360 = 25.0% / 150/600 = 25.0% — but 90/660 = 13.6% / 150/1110 = 13.5%, half every other plan's share. Majority (pricing.md, /pricing card, /model-credits) records 660/1,110; the $360/$600 table is coherent only with its own 7-day pair and would reset a user at half the expected week share. Left open.

notes: Sources disagree in three ways: per-plan caps on Pro/Max, a missing Haiku row, and two plan-name spellings. All three are in `conflicts`; none was smoothed.
Two figures rest on a single page and are named as such: original DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 7-day/5-hour on Go ($30/$10), and the GLM-5.3 Flash-X (2x) / GPT-6 Luna (4x) multipliers.
A `null` cap means the page publishes no such window. `0` means it publishes an explicit zero (only Go Top Model Credits).
Both zh editions of /help/billing and /model-credits were fetched and agree with their English twins on every figure, including the absent Haiku row — so the omissions are real, not a failed fetch.
The expired October off-peak promo still ships as a hidden DOM row with a live countdown; its 0.25x and $60/week are recorded in `promotions` only so they are not mistaken for standing values.
No page fetched today publishes the string Design Plan; it survives only as the anchor id on /model-credits multipliers heading.
core/od.json previously carried Claude Haiku 5.5 at 2x. No page publishes 2 for it; the value here is 4 with multiplierConflict set.
